224-1772-3861-8345.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

567-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

944-2701-4477-7182.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Planar Gate
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2292-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2292-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

215-6965-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-6965-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-3318.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2374-2841-3318.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2281-3899-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-6495-7056.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-5258-5618-6495-7056.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos

333-728-2730.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-728-2730.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

730-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4247-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

225-3129-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-5223-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2963-4377-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Teleportation Circle.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1432-4513-7203.description:
Activate Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind by tapping it, adding at least {G/W}{G/W}.
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind
Repeat.

206-222-527-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1379-3259-5953-7297.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-5953-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-5953-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

489-1020-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Nylea.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Nylea.
Repeat.

1682-1879-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-1879-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1168-1479-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1168-1479-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3685-3698-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3685-3698-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability and Grinding Station trigger, with Spine of Ish Sah targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 4.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

454-1902-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
454-1902-1978.description:
Cause Wirewood Channeler to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1336-1978-2392.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat

997-2173-3652-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2921-3234-3293-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2921-3234-3293-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat
2921-3234-3293-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

38-2173-2324-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

654-678-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping them.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1742-2498-3583.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

394-4050-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

862-2511-5220-5683.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2061-5733-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-5733-5913.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

511-817-1308-3062-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

4094-4636-5391.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

141-1418-4013-4176.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} available if Naru Meha is in your hand, or {3}{C}{U} otherwise
141-1418-4013-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
141-1418-4013-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting Karn's ability.
Holding priority, if Naru Meha is in your hand, cast it by paying {2}{U}{U}.
If Naru Meha is on the battlefield, activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 4.
If you control four or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, which can be used to copy Vantress Visions infinitely targeting any other abilities on the stack, or to blink any number of creatures infinitely.

1437-4365-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Mondrak has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have an artifact card or a creature card with haste in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have enough mana to cast the artifact or creature card.
1437-4365-4613.description:
Cast the artifact spell or creature spell with haste by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Mondrak using Myojin of Cryptic Dreams' ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the artifact or creature spell three times.
Resolve the three artifact or creature spell copies, creating six token copies of the artifact or creature.
Activate three tokens by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {3} and sacrificing two of the tokens, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may cast any other artifact and/or creature cards in your hand, and use Mondrak to get infinite copies of them.

777-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
777-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1864-2481-2863.manaNeeded: {8}{B}{R}{R}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-2481-2863.notablePrerequisites: You have no more than three opponents.
1864-2481-2863.description:
Cast Prossh by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating at least six 0/1 Kobold of Kher Keep creature tokens.
Activate Prossh six times by sacrificing six Kobold of Kher Keep tokens, giving Prossh +6/+0 until end of turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Xenagos triggers, giving Prossh +X/+X and haste until end of turn, where X is Prossh's power.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Prossh, causing an opponent to be dealt at least twenty-two commander damage.
The opponent loses the game due to being dealt twenty-one or more combat damage by your commander.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
If Seize the Day is in your hand, cast it by paying {3}{R}.
Otherwise, cast it from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}.
Resolve Sieze the Day, untapping Prossh and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4 until each opponent has lost the game.

364-1987-3227-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.

659-1636.description:
Tap Krenko to activate it's ability, creating X goblin tokens where X is the number of Goblins you control.
Token's ETB causes Intruder Alarm to trigger, untapping Krenko.
